content.description:
Your friendly go-to wallet for DeFi and NFTs. Flint is a friendly go-to wallet for DeFi and NFTs.

As a light wallet, Flint allows you to easily manage multiple assets from different chains in your browser. With native support for interoperability standards, Flint provides a smooth experience no matter which platform you need to use.
